title: Indian Pea Curry
description: A warm and comforting Indian-inspired pea curry made with fresh peas and a blend of spices.

ingredients.name: Fresh Peas
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen peas work well for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.notes: Coconut oil adds a unique flavor to the curry.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chopped onion adds a sweet and savory flavor.

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Fresh ginger adds a warm and spicy flavor.

ingredients.name: Cumin Powder
ingredients.notes: Cumin powder adds a warm and earthy flavor.

ingredients.name: Coriander Powder
ingredients.notes: Coriander powder adds a warm and citrusy flavor.

ingredients.name: Turmeric Powder
ingredients.notes: Turmeric powder adds a bright and earthy flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Salt enhances the flavors of the curry.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Water helps to thin out the curry to the desired consistency.

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until it's translucent.
Add the fresh ginger and sauté for another minute.
Add the cumin powder, coriander powder, and turmeric powder. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the fresh peas and cook until they're tender.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve the curry hot over rice or with naan bread.
